```{r, setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = '.')
```


```{r}
library(biomaRt)
```


# Retreive GeneID mapping table from Ensembl using biomaRt package
```{r}
bm <- getBM(
  mart = useEnsembl('genes','mmusculus_gene_ensembl',mirror = "uswest"),
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id","entrezgene_id","mgi_id","hgnc_id","external_gene_name")
)
write.table(bm,file="geneid_map.tsv",sep="\t",row.names = FALSE)
```
